brief: Apple design dominance, preserving the expanded hotel functions and real photography. The latest user correction supersedes the Bodoni/bronze hospitality system.
recommendation: Use an Apple product-page structure for the homepage and feature/detail pages. Use the clear lineup/comparison pattern only where guests choose rooms. Keep the hotel identity in the photographs, room facts, dining, location and booking tasks.

research.route: agent-reach; Jina Reader for official pages; existing decoded browser captures for visual inspection

currentOfficialPagesRead.observation: The page connects a photographic introduction, model selection, discrete feature groups, comparison and direct shopping assistance. Browsing and purchasing have explicit, separate actions.
The product presentation uses a large focused visual, short explanatory chapters and an explicit purchase route. Deeper technical detail follows the central product story.
Motion should explain an interaction, remain brief and interruptible, and respect preferences. Important information should not depend on animation.

augustoSystem.type: One neutral sans family. Root uses Inter600/650. Page headings80/84desktop and48/52mobile; major section headings64/68desktop and40/44mobile. Body18desktop and17mobile in long feature text. Credits12px; functional metadata14px or larger.
augustoSystem.spacing: Use104-112px major desktop separation and72px mobile separation;24-32px gaps within related content. Root container max1480px with80px desktop and24px mobile gutters.
augustoSystem.surfaces: Near-white main surface, cool light gray feature panels, charcoal text and cobalt actions. Root token definitions are authoritative. Rounded photography24-28px, primary action52px tall.
augustoSystem.heroComposition: A clean hotel introduction and clear enquiry action followed by one large genuine property photograph. Keep the photo visible early on mobile. Use minimal overlay copy; do not darken the entire hotel interior to make a slogan readable.
augustoSystem.photoTreatment: Real room, restaurant and hotel photographs are the primary identity. Use generous even framing and accurate captions. Place destination photographs in city content with explicit labels and retained credits.
augustoSystem.motion: Retain the existing reduced-motion-aware reveals and short tab/photo transitions. Keep native scrolling, immediate booking access and visible server-rendered content. Existing native inert wrappers must remain separate from animated copy children.
augustoSystem.conversion: Keep a persistent booking action, dates/guest enquiry, three visible room choices, room comparison, dining, services, arrival guidance, source-backed reviews, FAQs, gallery and guides. WhatsApp remains an enquiry, not live inventory or a completed reservation.
augustoSystem.copy: Prefer hotel/place/room names and concrete guest tasks. Remove generic romantic claims, decorative numbered chapters and invented luxury positioning.

currentDesignAntipatterns.issue: Bodoni display, italic headline offsets, bronze actions and warm paper dominate the identity. A font-only replacement would leave the old composition intact.
Layered dark veils, tracked labels and many competing hero controls make the initial view read as an editorial hotel template instead of a focused product presentation.

Overlapping inset photos, italic room numbering and staggered gallery tiles are ornamental visual signals. Replace these with clearly framed, large property images and predictable comparison alignment.
Several practical labels and captions fall to10-12px. Keep primary reading and booking information comfortably readable.

currentDesignAntipatterns.source: app/editorial-pages.css and app/guides/guides.css before this revision
currentDesignAntipatterns.issue: Serif text, sharp small-corner panels and uneven gallery columns extended the rejected style to the secondary pages.

changes: Cleaned the existing styles in place rather than appending an override layer.
Changed secondary typography to the shared sans family and600weight with the agreed heading scale.
Changed gallery to an even two-column photographic grid and a rounded segmented filter.
Kept native gallery dialog, filter counts, keyboard controls, swipe and focus return unchanged.
Changed city itinerary to a segmented selector and removed decorative chapter numbers.
Retained native inert wrappers, stable-height panel layout and reduced-motion behavior.
Replaced ornamental city/guide headings with direct destination and planning language.
Kept all guide content, facts, source links, photo licensing and city anchors.
